rows.text: The Speaker's decision of 1 June 1993 summarises the written statement filed on 11-8-1992: S/Shri Ajit Singh, Rashid Masood, Harpal Panwar and Satyapal Singh Yadav 'were expelled from the primary membership of Janata Dal By Shri S. R. Bommai, President of the Janata Dal. Shri Ajit Singh was expelled on 26-12-1991.'

The same written statement says that S/Shri R. Sonker Shastri, Ramnihore Rai, Ram Awadh and Shivsharan Verma 'were expelled from the primary membership of the Party by Shri S. R. Bommai, President of the Janata Dal on 19-7-1992'.

In the petition against S/Shri Ajit Singh and three others the decision records that 'the Respondents claimed that on 5-2-1992, the Janata Dal was split and Shri Ajit Singh was endorsed as the President of the Party' (paragraph 20; paragraph 242 has 'endorsed as the President of the original Janata Dal').
